clue.text: Big noises in the disco from sparklers that go bang?

definitions.meaning: big noises are celebrities, here famous chart singers played at a disco
fireworks: twinkling points of light that burst with a crack

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether disco celebrities come from exploding fireworks.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the second half literally: celestial sparklers that burst with a bang.
explanation.definitionFit: Famous chart singers are celebrities, the big names whose records fill a disco.

clue.text: Casual girl friend in the groove when it is put on record

definitions.meaning: a casual acquaintance met by chance, as at a bar

definitions.text: in the groove when it is put on record
definitions.meaning: the arm and stylus of a record player sit in the groove of a disc while it plays

explanation.surface: A casual girlfriend seems to be in the groove once she is mentioned on the record.
explanation.definitionFit: A chance acquaintance is so called, and so is the stylus cartridge that sits in a vinyl disc's groove.

clue.text: Those seek custom may just be wiry twisters

definitions.meaning: those who ply for trade, as cabbies and hawkers solicit customers
a gripping hand tool used to bend and twist wire

explanation.surface: People touting for business might be wiry, twisting characters.
explanation.walkthrough: The verb 'ply' (to seek trade) gives a noun for those who do it, which is also the name of the tool.
explanation.definitionFit: People who ply for trade are so named, and the gripping tool that bends wire carries the same name.

clue.text: Eat up, and I'll see you comfortably to bed

definitions.meaning: to eat heartily, an invitation to start a meal

definitions.text: I'll see you comfortably to bed
definitions.meaning: a parent folding the bedclothes snugly round a child

explanation.surface: A carer urges someone to finish their meal and promises to settle them in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both an urging to eat heartily and the act of folding bedclothes snugly round a sleeper.

clue.text: Vote on the motion if you want to catch the chairman's eye

definitions.meaning: show support in a meeting by lifting an arm when a motion is put

definitions.text: if you want to catch the chairman's eye
definitions.meaning: lifting an arm is how you signal the chair that you wish to speak

explanation.surface: Procedure at a meeting: how to vote and how to get noticed by the chair.
explanation.definitionFit: Lifting an arm is both a way of voting in a meeting and a way of signalling to the chair.

clue.text: Stiff drink makes one strut

definitions.meaning: a strong drink taken to fortify oneself
something that braces, a support or prop

explanation.surface: A strong drink gives someone a swagger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strut' looks like a verb (swagger) but is a noun: a supporting brace.
explanation.definitionFit: A reviving drink steadies the nerves, and a support that braces a structure is also so named.

clue.text: Impatient advice to one who is too often 10

definitions.meaning: fidgety, unable to keep still

definitions.text: advice to one who is too often 10
definitions.meaning: 10 refers to the answer to 10 across, sleeping, so the advice to a frequent sleeper is to repose less

explanation.surface: Restive advice offered to someone who keeps dozing off.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits as two words, an instruction to take less repose; '10' points to the 10-across answer, sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fidgety and unable to settle is a synonym for impatient.

clue.text: Haydn work produced by a haute couture

definitions.meaning: Joseph Haydn's oratorio about Genesis
a new garment designed by a fashion house

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a piece of Haydn came from a fashion house.
explanation.definitionFit: Haydn's famous oratorio bears this name, and a designer's new garment is also called by it.

clue.text: Was sorry for pent in deer being upset

indicators.note: one word is placed inside the other, as the clue says one is in the other
being upset means the letters of deer are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone regrets shutting a deer in, now that it is distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being upset' looks like it describes the deer's distress, but it is the anagram signal; 'pent' is an old word for shut in, used here as fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling remorse for a deed is the sense of regretting it.

clue.text: Toast down which the melted butter dribbles twice

indicators.note: twice says the part of the face is written two times in a row

parts.words: down which the melted butter dribbles
parts.note: the chin is the part of the face that greasy butter runs down

explanation.surface: A picture of buttered toast dribbling down someone's face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toast' looks like the buttered bread, but it is the drinking salute, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an old-fashioned drinking salute, said when raising glasses.

clue.text: Don't disturb please!

indicators.note: to disturb is to throw out of order, so the letters of please are jumbled

explanation.surface: A sign hung on a hotel door asking not to be woken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturb' rearranges PLEASE, and the whole clue is the notice for someone sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeping person is the one a do-not-disturb notice protects.

clue.text: Like a question which is not brought up, certainly not brought up

definitions.text: Like a question which is not brought up
definitions.meaning: a matter never mentioned or put forward for discussion
not lifted or elevated

explanation.surface: A matter that never gets mentioned stays firmly unmentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: A question never mentioned has not been put forward, and something not lifted has not been elevated.

clue.text: Briefly place an X on the typewriter

parts.note: Pl. is the short form of Place in street addresses
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: An instruction to type an X quickly on a typewriter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Briefly' signals the abbreviation of 'place'; 'X' is the Roman numeral, not a typed letter.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the roller on a typewriter against which the paper is struck.

clue.text: Piece of a piece one hears is all harassed parents want

indicators.note: one hears means the words are taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: a fragment of a piece is a bit of it

explanation.surface: Weary parents just want a little calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one hears' turns the PIECE of 'a bit of piece' into its sound-alike, giving the calm that parents crave.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted parents long for a short spell of quiet and calm.

clue.text: Sort of shop which keeps 22 yards in stock?

parts.note: a chain is an old surveyor's measure of 22 yards, the length of a cricket pitch
a store is a stock or supply

explanation.surface: A shop that keeps a measure of rope or tape in stock.
explanation.walkthrough: A chain is an old British length of 22 yards, the length of a cricket pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of many shops under one owner, a type of retail outlet.

clue.text: Redundant employee makes a plea for a stay of execution

definitions.meaning: a worker who is surplus to need

definitions.text: a plea for a stay of execution
definitions.meaning: a cry to the executioner: let me live, fellow

explanation.surface: A sacked worker begs not to lose their job.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the second sense into a plea addressed to a man: show mercy, mate.
explanation.definitionFit: A surplus worker is an extra hand with nothing to do, and the second reading is a cry for mercy.

clue.text: Early Jewish ascetic sect taken in by the Lord waned

indicators.note: taken in by means the sect's name goes inside the title's letters

parts.note: Ld is the abbreviation for Lord
the Essenes were an ascetic Jewish sect around the time of Christ

explanation.surface: An ancient sect, welcomed by God, faded away.
explanation.definitionFit: To wane is to diminish or grow smaller.

clue.text: Seek permission to question holiday entitlement

parts.note: leave is time off allowed from work

explanation.surface: An employee queries how much holiday they are due.
explanation.definitionFit: Requesting authority to do something is seeking permission.

clue.text: Continuing bravely, despite what the shoe is doing to the bunion

definitions.meaning: persevering, pushing forward regardless

definitions.text: what the shoe is doing to the bunion
definitions.meaning: a tight shoe squeezes against a painful foot swelling

explanation.surface: Someone walks on bravely despite a shoe squeezing a sore foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Persevering is carrying on regardless, and a tight shoe squeezes against a sore toe joint.

clue.text: A number committed perjury-in cahoots no doubt

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to commit perjury is to have told a falsehood under oath

explanation.surface: Several witnesses lied in court, clearly conspiring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is a Roman numeral, L for fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in league with others means being united as partners.

clue.text: Wrench obtained by gunner in the middle of a trip by car

indicators.note: in the middle of places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a spin is a short drive for pleasure
RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners

explanation.surface: Someone injured a joint on a drive, helped by a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, the Royal Artillery of the British Army, stands for a gunner.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrench is a twisting injury to a joint.

clue.text: They measure Middle East disturbance of the rest

indicators.note: a disturbance throws the letters of rest into a new order

explanation.surface: A news line about Middle East unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: Gauges that record quantities such as gas or electricity used are measuring instruments.

clue.text: Outcome of partitioning Ulster

indicators.note: partitioning breaks the word up and so reorders its letters

explanation.surface: The consequences of dividing Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: Ulster, the northern province of Ireland, was partitioned; here 'partitioning' rearranges its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A consequence or end product is an outcome.

clue.text: A pastry which stops one getting to sleep easily?

definitions.meaning: a fruit tart baked in a crust

definitions.text: which stops one getting to sleep easily?
definitions.meaning: a prank bed with the sheet folded so the sleeper cannot stretch out

explanation.surface: A heavy dessert keeps someone awake at night.
explanation.walkthrough: An apple-pie bed is a schoolboy prank: the sheet is folded back so the victim cannot get their legs down.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a fruit tart, and also names a prank bed made so its sleeper cannot stretch out.

clue.text: Handy reference book

definitions.meaning: done by hand
a handbook of instructions

explanation.surface: A reference book that comes in useful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handy' looks like 'useful' but means 'done by hand'.
explanation.definitionFit: It means worked by hand, and it is also an instruction handbook.

clue.text: It calls for adjusting either the TV screen or your manner of presentation

definitions.text: It calls for adjusting either the TV screen or your manner of presentation

parts.words: It calls for adjusting either the TV screen or your manner of presentation
parts.note: a poor picture on a television set and a poor public impression both need correcting

explanation.surface: Advice to fix either the television or the way you come across.
explanation.definitionFit: A poor picture on a set and a poor public impression share this phrase.

clue.text: Agreed only because one was so tired?

definitions.meaning: signalled assent with a dip of the head

definitions.text: only because one was so tired?
definitions.meaning: one's head dropped while dozing off

explanation.surface: Someone only seemed to agree because they were drowsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Assent is shown with a dip of the head, and a drowsy head drops the same way.

clue.text: Bible lessons taken by those who look at down

definitions.meaning: passages of scripture read aloud in church

definitions.text: taken by those who look at down
definitions.meaning: the figures recorded by those checking gauges such as the meters of 21 down

explanation.surface: Scripture passages are read by people looking down at the page.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down' most likely points to 21 down, meters: the figures that meter-checkers record.
explanation.definitionFit: Passages from scripture read in a service are lessons, and figures taken from gauges share the name.
